notes: Fixed question set for the monthly AI citation eval. Edit freely: the runner reads ids, so keep ids stable when rewording, and only add new ids for genuinely new questions. target_url is the page we would want cited; null where no single page owns the answer. Band e is the control set: we do not expect citations there today.
